newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT -Nordstrom upgraded to buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT -Nordstrom upgraded to buy.

text.p: - Rodman & Renshaw said it upgraded Nordstrom Inc to a buy rating from a neutral rating and raised fiscal 1998 second quarter earnings estimates based on higher than expected first quarter earnings and gross margins.

- Rodman & Renshaw analysts Harry Ikenson and Evelyn Krache said they raised fiscal 1998 second quarter earnings estimates for the retailer by $0.07 a share to $0.66 to reflect continued improvement in gross margins and expense control.
- The analysts raised fiscal 1998 year estimates to $2.25 from $2.10 and raised fiscal 1999 to $2.55, from $2.45.
- Shares of Nordstrom were trading up 1-7/8 to 44-1/2.
